+"""Bounded card-only payoff qualification; full admission gates remain mandatory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json,subprocess,os,hashlib,traceback,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from collections import Counter
+R=Path.cwd(); H=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+P=json.loads((H/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text()); O=R/P['evidence']
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
+def save(p,b):
+ p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
+def js(p,v):save(p,(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
+paths=P['paths']+[P['test']]
+normal={p:(R/p).read_bytes() for p in paths}
+def restore():
+ for p,b in normal.items():(R/p).write_bytes(b)
+def bind(label):
+ assert git('rev-parse',os.environ['SOURCE']+'^{tree}')==os.environ['SOURCE_TREE']
+ assert git('rev-parse',os.environ['SOURCE']+'^')==P['base']
+ assert git('rev-parse','HEAD^')==os.environ['SOURCE']
+ assert git('diff','--name-only',os.environ['SOURCE'],'HEAD')==os.environ['WORKFLOW']
+ assert git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')==P['main']
+ assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')
+ delta=git('diff','--name-only',P['base'],os.environ['SOURCE']).splitlines()
+ assert sorted(delta)==sorted(P['changed_paths']+[str(H.relative_to(R)/n) for n in ['PROTOCOL.json','run.py','validation.just']]),delta
+ protected={}
+ for p in P['unaffected']:
+  a=git('rev-parse',P['base']+':'+p);b=git('rev-parse',os.environ['SOURCE']+':'+p)
+  assert a==b,p;protected[p]=b
+ for p in paths:assert (R/p).read_bytes()==normal[p]
+ js(O/label/'PROTECTED.json',protected)
+def stage(form,recipe,label=None):
+ restore()
+ if form!='normal':
+  m=next(m for m in P['mutations'] if m['id']==form)
+  p=R/m['path'];s=p.read_text();assert s.count(m['before'])==1
+  p.write_text(s.replace(m['before'],m['after']))
+ folder=O/(label or (recipe+'-'+form));folder.mkdir(parents=True)
+ for p in paths:save(folder/'source'/p,(R/p).read_bytes())
+ js(folder/'SOURCE_HASHES.json',{p:sha((R/p).read_bytes()) for p in paths})
+ for p in R.glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'):
+  if O not in p.parents:p.unlink()
+ env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('KOTEST_INCLUDE_PATTERN','UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS')}
+ with (folder/'output.log').open('wb') as f:
+  rc=subprocess.run(['just','--working-directory',str(R),'--justfile',str(H/'validation.just'),recipe],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env).returncode
+ (folder/'exit.txt').write_text(str(rc)+'\n')
+ reports=[p for p in R.glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml') if O not in p.parents]
+ if recipe=='compile':
+  log=(folder/'output.log').read_text(errors='replace')
+  assert rc==0 and 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in log and ':mtg-sets:2024:tests:compileTestKotlin' in log and not reports,(form,rc)
+  return
+ rows=[]
+ for p in reports:
+  save(folder/'junit'/p.relative_to(R),p.read_bytes())
+  for c in ET.parse(p).getroot().iter('testcase'):
+   rows.append(dict(name=c.get('name'),classname=c.get('classname'),failures=[dict(type=n.get('type'),message=n.get('message'),text=n.text) for n in c.findall('failure')],errors=[dict(type=n.get('type'),message=n.get('message'),text=n.text) for n in c.findall('error')],skipped=len(c.findall('skipped'))))
+ assert Counter(r['name'] for r in rows)==Counter(P['case_names']),rows
+ assert all(r['classname']==P['class'] and r['skipped']==0 for r in rows)
+ failed=sum(bool(r['failures'] or r['errors']) for r in rows)
+ assert rc in (0,1) and (rc!=0)==bool(failed),(rc,failed)
+ result=dict(form=form,total=len(rows),failed=failed,rows=rows,rc=rc)
+ js(folder/'REPORT.json',result);return result
+def main():
+ O.mkdir();bind('initial')
+ for p in H.iterdir():
+  if p.is_file():save(O/'protocol'/p.name,p.read_bytes())
+ save(O/'WORKFLOW.yml',(R/os.environ['WORKFLOW']).read_bytes())
+ js(O/'BINDING.json',dict(source=os.environ['SOURCE'],tree=os.environ['SOURCE_TREE'],validation=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),validation_tree=git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),workflow=os.environ['WORKFLOW'],workflow_blob=git('hash-object',os.environ['WORKFLOW']),run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],attempt=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],run_number=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER']))
+ assert os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']==os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER']=='1'
+ for form in P['forms']:stage(form,'compile')
+ js(O/'ALL_FORMS_COMPILED.json',P['forms'])
+ results={form:stage(form,'observe') for form in P['forms']}
+ restored=stage('normal','observe','observe-restored')
+ js(O/'RESTORED_REPORT.json',restored)
+ for form,v in results.items():
+  assert v['failed']==P['expected_failed'][form],(form,v['failed'])
+  assert Counter(r['name'] for r in v['rows'] if r['failures'] or r['errors'])==Counter(P['expected_failed_identities'][form]),form
+  assert all(not r['errors'] for r in v['rows']),form
+ assert restored['failed']==0
+ byname=lambda v:{r['name']:r for r in v['rows']}
+ positives=byname(results['normal']);recovered=byname(restored)
+ witnesses={}
+ for form,w in P['required_witnesses'].items():
+  row=byname(results[form])[w['case']]
+  assert not positives[w['case']]['failures'] and not recovered[w['case']]['failures']
+  assert not row['errors'] and any(f['type']=='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError' and
+   ('DiscipleOfFreyaliseScenarioTest.kt:'+str(w['line'])) in (f['text'] or '') for f in row['failures']),form
+  assert normal[P['test']].decode().splitlines()[w['line']-1].strip()==w['assertion']
+  witnesses[form]=row
+ for form,v in results.items():
+  for r in v['rows']:
+   if r['name'] in P['unaffected_controls']:assert not r['failures'] and not r['errors']
+ js(O/'WITNESSES.json',witnesses)
+ restore();bind('restored')
+ js(O/'RESULT.json',dict(counts={k:dict(total=v['total'],failed=v['failed']) for k,v in results.items()},restored_failed=restored['failed'],admitted=False,original_receiving_required=True))
+ return 1 if results['normal']['failed'] or restored['failed'] else 0
+status=1
+try:status=main()
+except Exception:
+ O.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(O/'FAILURE.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
+finally:
+ restore()
+ try:bind('final')
+ except Exception:
+  O.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(O/'FINAL_BINDING_FAILURE.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc());status=1
+ O.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+ js(O/'MANIFEST.json',{str(p.relative_to(O)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(O.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name!='MANIFEST.json'})
+raise SystemExit(status)

+            d.getHand(player).toList().forEach { d.moveToGraveyard(it) }
+        }
+        repeat(2) {
+            d.passPriorityUntil(Step.POSTCOMBAT_MAIN)
+            d.passPriorityUntil(Step.PRECOMBAT_MAIN)
+        }
+        d.activePlayer shouldBe me
+        d.state.mayPlayPermissions.any { it.id == permission.id } shouldBe false
+        d.legalActions(me).map { it.action }.filterIsInstance<PlayLand>()
+            .count { it.cardId == id } shouldBe 0
+        val before = d.state
+        val rejected = d.submit(PlayLand(me, id, asBackFace = true))
+        (rejected.error != null) shouldBe true
+        rejected.events.size shouldBe 0
+        d.state shouldBe before
+    }
+
+    test("DF19 per-card permission does not admit a command-zone Garden") {
+        val d = driver()
+        val me = d.activePlayer!!
+        val id = d.putCardInCommandZone(me, "Disciple of Freyalise")
+        d.replaceState(d.state.addMayPlayPermission(MayPlayPermission(
+            id = EntityId.generate(), cardIds = setOf(id), controllerId = me, timestamp = d.state.timestamp)))
+        d.legalActions(me).map { it.action }.filterIsInstance<PlayLand>()
+            .count { it.cardId == id } shouldBe 0
+        val before = d.state
+        val rejected = d.submit(PlayLand(me, id, asBackFace = true))
+        (rejected.error != null) shouldBe true
+        rejected.events.size shouldBe 0
+        d.state shouldBe before
+    }
+
+    listOf("nonmain", "nonactive", "stack").forEach { restriction ->
+        test("DF19 permitted Garden respects timing restriction=$restriction") {
+            val d = driver()
+            val me = d.activePlayer!!
+            val id = d.putCardInExile(me, "Disciple of Freyalise")
+            d.replaceState(d.state.addMayPlayPermission(MayPlayPermission(
+                id = EntityId.generate(), cardIds = setOf(id), controllerId = me,
+                permanent = true, asThoughFlash = true, timestamp = d.state.timestamp)))
+            when (restriction) {
+                "nonmain" -> d.passPriorityUntil(Step.BEGIN_COMBAT)
+                "nonactive" -> {
+                    d.passPriorityUntil(Step.POSTCOMBAT_MAIN)
+                    d.passPriorityUntil(Step.PRECOMBAT_MAIN)
+                    d.activePlayer shouldBe d.getOpponent(me)
+                }
+                "stack" -> {
+                    val front = d.putCardInHand(me, "Disciple of Freyalise")
+                    d.giveMana(me, Color.GREEN, 3)
+                    d.giveColorlessMana(me, 3)
+                    d.castSpell(me, front).isSuccess shouldBe true
+                    d.state.stack.size shouldBe 1
+                }
+            }
+            d.legalActions(me).map { it.action }.filterIsInstance<PlayLand>()
+                .count { it.cardId == id } shouldBe 0
+            val before = d.state
+            val rejected = d.submit(PlayLand(me, id, asBackFace = true))
+            (rejected.error != null) shouldBe true
+            rejected.events.size shouldBe 0
+            d.state shouldBe before
+        }
+    }
+
+    test("DF19 land prohibition defeats a per-card play permission") {
+        val d = driver()
+        val me = d.activePlayer!!
+        d.registerCard(card("Disciple land prohibition fixture") {
+            typeLine = "Enchantment"
+            staticAbility(com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.PlayersCantPlayLands())
+        })
+        d.putPermanentOnBattlefield(me, "Disciple land prohibition fixture")
+        val id = d.putCardInExile(me, "Disciple of Freyalise")
+        d.replaceState(d.state.addMayPlayPermission(MayPlayPermission(
+            id = EntityId.generate(), cardIds = setOf(id), controllerId = me, timestamp = d.state.timestamp)))
+        d.legalActions(me).map { it.action }.filterIsInstance<PlayLand>()
+            .count { it.cardId == id } shouldBe 0
+        val before = d.state
+        val rejected = d.submit(PlayLand(me, id, asBackFace = true))
+        (rejected.error != null) shouldBe true
+        rejected.events.size shouldBe 0
+        d.state shouldBe before
+    }
+
+    listOf(false, true).forEach { shallow ->
+        test("DF16 Garden payment uses existing library replacement shallow=$shallow") {
+            val d = driver()
+            val me = d.activePlayer!!
+            d.registerCard(card("Disciple payment replacement fixture") {
+                typeLine = "Enchantment"
+                replacementEffect(com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.ReplaceLifePaymentWithLibraryExile())
+            })
+            d.putPermanentOnBattlefield(me, "Disciple payment replacement fixture")
+            if (shallow) {
+                d.state.getLibrary(me).drop(2).forEach { d.moveToGraveyard(it) }
+            }
+            val library = d.state.getLibrary(me).toList()
+            val exile = d.getExile(me).toSet()
+            val id = d.putCardInHand(me, "Disciple of Freyalise")
+            d.submit(PlayLand(me, id, asBackFace = true)).error shouldBe null
+            roundtrip(d)
+            d.submitYesNo(me, true).error shouldBe null
+            d.getLifeTotal(me) shouldBe if (shallow) 17 else 20
+            d.state.getLibrary(me) shouldBe if (shallow) library else library.drop(3)
+            (d.getExile(me).toSet() - exile) shouldBe if (shallow) emptySet() else library.take(3).toSet()
+            d.isTapped(id) shouldBe false
+            d.getLands(me).count { it == id } shouldBe 1
+            d.pendingDecision shouldBe null
+        }
+    }
+
+    listOf(false, true).forEach { accept ->
+        test("DF16 serialized Garden entry emits one identity and one landfall accept=$accept") {
+            val d = driver()
+            val me = d.activePlayer!!
+            d.registerCard(card("Disciple landfall observer fixture") {
+                typeLine = "Enchantment"
+                triggeredAbility {
+                    trigger = com.wingedsheep.sdk.dsl.Triggers.LandYouControlEnters
+                    effect = com.wingedsheep.sdk.dsl.Effects.GainLife(1)
+                }
+            })
+            val observer = d.putPermanentOnBattlefield(me, "Disciple landfall observer fixture")
+            val id = d.putCardInHand(me, "Disciple of Freyalise")
+            val oldObject = d.state.objectRef(id)
+            val start = d.events.size
+            d.submit(PlayLand(me, id, asBackFace = true)).error shouldBe null
+            val enteredObject = d.state.objectRef(id)
+            roundtrip(d)
+            d.submitYesNo(me, accept).error shouldBe null
+            val events = d.events.drop(start)
+            val entries = events.filterIsInstance<com.wingedsheep.engine.core.ZoneChangeEvent>()
+                .filter { it.entityId == id && it.toZone == Zone.BATTLEFIELD }
+            entries.size shouldBe 1
+            entries.single().oldObject shouldBe oldObject
+            entries.single().newObject shouldBe enteredObject
+            (oldObject != enteredObject) shouldBe true
+            events.filterIsInstance<com.wingedsheep.engine.core.LandPlayedEvent>()
+                .count { it.cardId == id } shouldBe 1
+            events.filterIsInstance<com.wingedsheep.engine.core.AbilityTriggeredEvent>()
+                .count { it.sourceId == observer } shouldBe 1
+            events.filterIsInstance<SpellCastEvent>().size shouldBe 0
+            d.state.stack.size shouldBe 1
+            d.bothPass().error shouldBe null
+            d.getLifeTotal(me) shouldBe if (accept) 18 else 21
+            d.isTapped(id) shouldBe !accept
+            d.getLands(me).count { it == id } shouldBe 1
+            d.state.stack.size shouldBe 0
+            d.pendingDecision shouldBe null
+        }
+    }
+
 })

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+name: Manual Disciple runtime extension R1
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [validation/manual-disciple-runtime-extension-r1-20261101]
+    paths: ['.github/workflows/manual-disciple-runtime-extension-r1-20261101.yml']
+permissions: {contents: read}
+concurrency:
+  group: manual-transmission-engine-qualification
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+env:
+  SOURCE: 9b46148f257b133bc4592729fddd3504732a710b
+  SOURCE_TREE: 7ddbd16e067c663d15534f51c43c62d87ddbb180
+  WORKFLOW: .github/workflows/manual-disciple-runtime-extension-r1-20261101.yml
+  RECORD: experiments/manual-transmission/research/disciple-runtime-extension-r1-20261101
+  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false
+  GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    if: github.run_number == 1 && github.run_attempt == 1
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with: {distribution: temurin, java-version: '21'}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: '22', cache: npm, cache-dependency-path: web-client/package-lock.json}
+      - name: Install approved locked recipe runner
+        run: |
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install -y just
+          command -v flock
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/argentum"
+      - name: Compile every diagnostic form before original behavioral observations
+        run: flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" python3 "$RECORD/run.py"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: manual-disciple-runtime-extension-r1-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: manual-disciple-runtime-extension-r1-evidence/
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
